title.narrative: The Results Reporting Project: Assistance to OpenAid revision

description.narrative: The consultancy aims at assisting the MFA in achieving improvements in results reporting on OpenAid, as identified during the diagnostic work in 2020.

The overall purpose of the results-reporting enhancement process of which the present assignment is part is threefold: (i) Comprehensive and timely information to the Danish Parliament and to the public on development results; (ii) Improvement of internal reporting and accountability structures making the results reporting at unit level more informative; and (iii) Preparation of an annual Ministry scorecard linked to the SDGs, which will allow linking Danish results with global progress. The consultancy aims at assisting the MFA in achieving improvements in results reporting on OpenAid, as identified during the diagnostic work in 2020.
